readme_excerpt: Select2 ![Build Status][github-actions-image] [ ][jsdelivr] [ ][cdnjs] Select2 is a jQuery-based replacement for select boxes. It supports searching, remote data sets, and pagination of results. To get started, check out examples and documentation at https://select2.org/ Use cases - Enhancing native selects with search. - Enhancing native selects with a better multi-select interface. - Loading data from JavaScript: easily load items via AJAX and have them searchable. - Nesting optgroups: native…
